faqs.q: How can I book Pakistan Railway tickets online?
faqs.a: You can book tickets through the official Pakistan Railways website or mobile app using cards or mobile wallets.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest train class?
faqs.a: Economy Class (Seat) is the most affordable option.
